obligations.expected_behavior: Enable an approved candidate so that evaluation makes a real Candidate call, verified with an isolated no-call-fixture fixture while all other inputs remain constant.
forbidden_result: The enabled approved candidate produces no real Candidate call.
The verification changes inputs other than the no-call-fixture condition.
obligations.observable_result: The isolated verification records a real Candidate call after enablement.
obligations.state_before: The candidate is approved, and the isolated no-call fixture represents the pre-change no-call condition.
obligations.subject: FR-10 candidate enable behavior
obligations.trigger: An approved candidate is enabled under the isolated no-call-fixture fixture.

obligations.expected_behavior: Disable an enabled candidate so that evaluation makes a real Prior call, verified with an isolated config-only-fixture fixture while all other inputs remain constant.
forbidden_result: The disabled candidate continues to produce a Candidate call instead of a real Prior call.
The verification changes inputs other than the config-only-fixture condition.
obligations.observable_result: The isolated verification records a real Prior call after disablement.
obligations.state_before: The candidate is enabled, and the isolated config-only fixture represents the condition used to verify disablement.
obligations.subject: FR-10 candidate disable behavior
obligations.trigger: An enabled candidate is disabled under the isolated config-only-fixture fixture.

obligations.expected_behavior: When rollback is applicable, restore the Prior identity, verdict, and category, verified with an isolated rejection-only-fixture fixture while all other inputs remain constant.
forbidden_result: Rollback leaves the Candidate identity, verdict, or category in effect.
The verification changes inputs other than the rejection-only-fixture condition.
obligations.observable_result: The isolated verification shows that Prior identity, verdict, and category are restored.
obligations.state_after: Prior identity, verdict, and category are restored.
obligations.state_before: Rollback is applicable, and the isolated rejection-only fixture represents the condition used to verify rollback.
obligations.subject: FR-10 rollback behavior
obligations.trigger: Rollback is applied under the isolated rejection-only-fixture fixture.

obligations.expected_behavior: Re-enable the current candidate so that evaluation makes a real Candidate call, verified with an isolated skip-fixture fixture while all other inputs remain constant.
forbidden_result: The re-enabled current candidate is skipped instead of producing a real Candidate call.
The verification changes inputs other than the skip-fixture condition.
obligations.observable_result: The isolated verification records a real Candidate call after re-enablement.
obligations.state_before: The candidate is current, and the isolated skip fixture represents the pre-change skip condition.
obligations.subject: FR-10 candidate re-enable behavior
obligations.trigger: The current candidate is re-enabled under the isolated skip-fixture fixture.
